Middle East Edition - Brand New, Factory Sealed, Complete Set, Full Warranty PRODUCT DESCRIPTION Pasha de Cartier watch, 41, Manufacture mechanical movement with automatic winding, caliber 1847 MC. Steel case, fluted crown cap and crown set with synthetic spinels, green flinqué dial, blued-steel diamond-shaped hands, steel bracelet with "SmartLink" adjustment system, second strap in green alligator skin, interchangeable steel deployant buckle. Both bracelets are fitted with the "QuickSwitch" interchangeability system. Case diameter: 41, thickness: 9.55. Water-resistant up to 10 bar (approx. 100 meters/330 feet). ABOUT THE COLLECTION A round wristwatch was introduced into the Cartier collection in 1943, and became the inspiration for the Pasha series. This unique timepiece exudes power and elegance through its construction, featuring: a round, water-resistant case, four Arabic numerals, a screw-down crown cap attached to the case by a small chain, and sword-shaped hands. The distinctive Pasha watch stands out, while at the same time, respects the Cartier watchmaking tradition.
